title: Say It in Go
story: Every Go program starts at main. Your first real program: print a greeting.
hints: Use fmt.Println with a string in double quotes.
The text must match exactly, including the comma and the exclamation mark.
socratic: What does Println add after your text?
Run it, then compare the output with the goal.
explain: In one sentence: what did you learn from “Say It in Go”?
